purpose: Fixture-specific, read-only inspection of four native Microsoft Word macro-enabled and legacy derivatives created with the real Word macro recorder.

provenance.authoring_method: Computer Use / native Microsoft Word UI with Record Macro
provenance.source: Synthetic content entered in native Word; one recording action, Cmd+B, saved explicitly in each document/template and exported through native Word Save As for DOCM, DOTM, DOC and DOT.
provenance.macro_storage: The recorded macro was stored in the current document/template rather than Normal.dotm.

expected_markers: The stored macro only applies bold formatting to the current selection.

macro_security_validation.scope: Native Word reopen validation only; the VBA source was inspected inertly by library readers.

recorded_action.source_behavior: Selection.Font.Bold = wdToggle toggles the current selection bold state when invoked.

library_validation.note: The readers decode metadata and inert source only; they do not compile, interpret, or execute VBA.
